configurations.name: Start server
configurations.command: if [ -n "$CODESPACES" ]; then echo 'Running in Codespaces'; browser-sync start --proxy 'localhost:4000' --files '_site/**/*' --port 4001 --socket.port 443 --socket.domain ${CODESPACE_NAME}-4001.app.github.dev & bundle exec jekyll serve; else echo 'Running locally'; bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload; python3 -m webbrowser "http://localhost:4000"; fi
